Nothing you write using the Ridmik Keyboard ever leaves your device. This has always been the case for the last 10+ years. For suggestion purposes, only your typed words and frequencies are stored in your phone in an unreadable format. Confidential information such as passwords or credit card information is never stored on your device. If anyone expresses doubts about this on social media, please ask for proof. To be completely safe, always install Ridmik Keyboard from the Play Store. We are always committed to protecting your personal information.

Ridmik Keyboard is used by over 50 million people. As a result, there may be millions of spins every day. However, we can currently provide free AI credits to up to 100,000 users each month through a random lottery. Because of this, the chance of winning is naturally low.

"The AI credits awarded through the spin wheel are not free for us. We purchase AI services from global providers such as OpenAI to power these features, and every AI credit has a real cost. For this reason, it isn't possible for us to offer free AI credits to everyone.

At the moment, we expect to provide free AI credits to around 100,000 users per month, funded primarily by our paid subscriptions and advertising revenue. Depending on our revenue, we may increase or decrease both the number of winners and the amount of AI credits awarded in the future.

Thank you for your understanding and support. ❤️"
